en.name: Web Automation
en.description: Arrange web actions on a canvas: click, type, wait, extract, branch and loop, with several locators per step. Scripts and runs are shared with agents; recording and replay need a newer App with the browser component and use myco's own browser profiles.

zh.name: 网页自动化
zh.description: 在画布上编排网页操作：点击、输入、等待、提取、分支和循环，每一步有多组定位器。脚本和运行记录共享给 agent 读写；录制和回放需要支持浏览器组件的新版 App，使用 myco 专用的浏览器 profile。
